name: SearXNG Private Metasearch + JSON API (Valkey Limiter)
description: Private metasearch for people and AI agents: JSON API, bot limiter.

PORT.description: HTTP port (public domain target and healthcheck).

SEARXNG_SECRET.description: Secret key that signs image-proxy links and limiter tokens, generated at deploy (min. 16 characters).

SEARXNG_BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this instance. Change it when you add a custom domain.

SEARXNG_VALKEY_URL.description: Valkey connection for the bot limiter (private network).

SEARXNG_LIMITER.description: Block bots and rate-limit clients on the public domain. Keep on: search engines block instances that pass bot traffic.

SEARXNG_PRIVATE_NETWORK_UNLIMITED.description: Let services in this Railway project (n8n, Open WebUI, agents) call the API over the private network without the limiter.

SEARXNG_LIMITER_PASS_IPS.description: Optional. Comma-separated public IPs or networks that may use the API over the public domain without the limiter, e.g. your agent server.

SEARXNG_LIMITER_BLOCK_IPS.description: Optional. Comma-separated IPs or networks to block.

SEARXNG_API_FORMATS.description: Output formats besides html: any of json, csv, rss. Empty = web page only.

SEARXNG_INSTANCE_NAME.description: Name shown in the browser tab and page header.

SEARXNG_SAFE_SEARCH.description: Default safe search: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 strict (users can change it in preferences).

SEARXNG_IMAGE_PROXY.description: Load result images through this instance so search engines don't see your visitors' IPs.

SEARXNG_METHOD.description: Form method for searches: GET (shareable URLs) or POST (queries kept out of logs and history).

SEARXNG_WORKERS.description: Web server processes (1-16). Each adds about 60-100 MB RAM.

SEARXNG_THREADS.description: Threads per process for concurrent searches (1-64).

Valkey.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'M="${VALKEY_MAXMEMORY_MB:-64}"; case "$M" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "valkey-start: VALKEY_MAXMEMORY_MB=$M is not a number, using 64"; M=64 ;; esac; if [ "$M" -lt 16 ]; then M=16; fi; echo "valkey-start: maxmemory ${M}mb, no persistence (limiter counters only)"; exec valkey-server --port 6379 --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no --maxmemory "${M}mb" --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru' valkey-start

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Password of the default user, generated at deploy (letters only, URL-safe).

VALKEY_MAXMEMORY_MB.description: Memory cap for limiter counters in MB; old keys are evicted at the cap.
